items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-11-10
items.q: You have Marshall Foch, General Diaz, General Haig, and... Where's Mouton? ... Named after the famous French general, Marshall. All of the streets in Lakeview are named after World War I.

ctx.x: Named after the famous French general, Marshall. All of the streets in Lakeview are named after World War I.

Uh-huh. You have Argonne. No, Argonne was World War II, wasn't it? No, that was one. I think my father was saying. Was that one? Argonne was World War I. You have Marshall Foch, General Diaz, General Haig, and... Where's Mouton? Mouton is over... Oh, I'll find her over there. It's across the street. Yeah. Yeah. You have Argonne. No, Argonne was World War II, wasn't it? No, that was one. Was that one?
The thing my father was saying.
